Curbstone Financial Management Corp trimmed its holdings in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 3.2% in the second quarter, according to its most recent disclosure with the SEC. The fund owned 41,672 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 1,378 shares during the period. Apple accounts for approximately 2.1% of Curbstone Financial Management Corp’s portfolio, making the stock its 8th largest position. Curbstone Financial Management Corp’s holdings in Apple were worth $7,714,000 as of its most recent SEC filing.
Several other large investors have also made changes to their positions in AAPL. First American Trust FSB raised its holdings in Apple by 21.5% during the second quarter. First American Trust FSB now owns 67,601 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $12,514,000 after purchasing an additional 11,951 shares in the last quarter. Clinton Group Inc. purchased a new position in Apple during the second quarter worth about $2,066,000. Stonebridge Capital Management Inc. raised its holdings in Apple by 464.1% during the second quarter. Stonebridge Capital Management Inc. now owns 54,246 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $10,058,000 after purchasing an additional 44,630 shares in the last quarter. Versant Capital Management Inc raised its holdings in Apple by 13.1% during the second quarter. Versant Capital Management Inc now owns 9,970 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,845,000 after purchasing an additional 1,156 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Rockland Trust Co. raised its holdings in Apple by 10.7% during the second quarter. Rockland Trust Co. now owns 20,820 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $3,854,000 after purchasing an additional 2,012 shares in the last quarter. 58.54% of the stock is owned by institutional investors and hedge funds. In other news, COO Jeffrey E. Williams sold 15,652 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Monday, July 9th. The shares were sold at an average price of $190.18, for a total value of $2,976,697.36. Following the sale, the chief operating officer now directly owns 125,258 shares in the company, valued at $23,821,566.44. The transaction was disclosed in a document filed with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which can be accessed through the SEC website . Also, CEO Timothy D. Cook sold 265,160 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Monday, August 27th. The stock was sold at an average price of $217.79, for a total transaction of $57,749,196.40. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders sold 378,400 shares of company stock worth $81,052,754 over the last quarter. Company insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock. Several research analysts recently issued reports on AAPL shares. BidaskClub raised shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating in a report on Tuesday, May 29th. Maxim Group cut shares of Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and cut their price target for the stock from $204.00 to $200.00 in a report on Wednesday, May 30th. UBS Group increased their price target on shares of Apple from $190.00 to $210.00 and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Friday, June 1st. Royal Bank of Canada increased their price target on shares of Apple from $203.00 to $210.00 and gave the stock an “outperform” rating in a report on Tuesday, June 5th. Finally, Goldman Sachs Group reissued a “neutral” rating and set a $164.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, June 5th. Two research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have issued a hold rating and twenty-nine have issued a buy rating to the company’s stock. The stock currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $217.53.
AAPL stock opened at $217.66 on Friday. The company has a market capitalization of $1,073.32 billion, a PE ratio of 23.63, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.92 and a beta of 1.33. Apple Inc. has a 12 month low of $149.16 and a 12 month high of $229.67. The company has a current ratio of 1.31, a quick ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 EPS for the quarter, beating the consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. The business had revenue of $53.27 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $52.43 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.98% and a return on equity of 43.50%. The company’s quarterly revenue was up 17.3% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period in the prior year, the business earned $1.67 earnings per share. equities analysts anticipate that Apple Inc. will post 11.76 EPS for the current fiscal year.
About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
